name: RakNet.send
description: Queues packet data for the RakNet send path. The packet can be a string, buffer, array table of byte numbers, RakNetPacket, or RakNetPacketTable. Raw data calls may also pass optional priority, reliability, and orderingChannel values.

parameters.name: packet
parameters.description: Packet data or packet object to queue. Array-table bytes must be numbers from 0 through 255.

parameters.name: priority
parameters.description: Optional priority used only for raw data calls. Defaults to 2.

parameters.name: reliability
parameters.description: Optional reliability used only for raw data calls. Defaults to 3.

parameters.name: orderingChannel
parameters.description: Optional ordering channel used only for raw data calls. Defaults to 0.
